Message:
cgroup,rcu: convert call_rcu(free_cgroup_rcu) to kfree_rcu()

The rcu callback free_cgroup_rcu() just calls a kfree(),
so we use kfree_rcu() instead of the call_rcu(free_cgroup_rcu).
